outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Shard Pavise Guard battle sprite pose sheet based on supplied original character. Preserve closed silver-blue visor, gold sun-crystal helmet crest, ivory and gold plate armor, white cloth with gold sun motif, blue undercloth, short blue crystal blade and huge tall faceted blue-white crystal pavise with gold ribs. Exactly SIXTEEN separate complete full-body poses in strict 4 columns x 4 rows. Same anatomical scale, same RIGHT-facing three-quarter tactical camera and consistent hands in every pose. Row1: idle shield upright blade low; quiet breathing idle with small elbow shift; walking contact left boot forward right boot behind; walking passing phase left leg supporting and right boot passing close to ground. Row2: opposite contact right boot forward left boot behind; opposite passing phase right leg supporting and left boot passing close to ground; blade drawn back windup with torso turned; strong forward short-blade thrust past edge of shield. Row3: attack recovery blade withdrawing; planted pavise brace with bent knees and shield firmly in front; blocked impact shield tilted slightly back with arms flexed; staggered hit torso recoiling and blade arm lowered. Row4: dying kneeling with head bowed and shield slipping; falling sideways knees giving way; landing low on side with shield beside body; final motionless dead knight fully horizontal on side, helmet resting on ground, relaxed limbs, shield and blade lying beside him. No blood. Walking must visibly alternate legs, low natural steps not high-knee marching. Death poses must change anatomy into an actual fallen body, never rotate a standing cutout. Large clear margins around every body, shield and weapon; no sprites cross cell boundaries. Detailed original painterly raster art. Uniform flat green RGB(0,255,0) backdrop including all gaps. No ground, cast shadows, labels, grid lines, checkerboard, text or effects.
